title: listensmith contract: shared definitions
$comment: Pinned (ruling I2) to the ListenBrainz JSON documentation, https://listenbrainz.readthedocs.io/en/latest/users/json.html, and its submit-listens API page, https://listenbrainz.readthedocs.io/en/latest/users/api/core.html, as read on 2026-11-08. The pages carry no version marker, so the date is the pin. Change these definitions only on purpose, recording the new date.

listened_at.$comment: ListenBrainz's earliest listened_at, up to the last second of 9999-12-31 UTC, unix_seconds' ceiling (ruling L1).

unix_seconds.$comment: A moment as Unix seconds, up to the last second of 9999-12-31 UTC.

music_count.$comment: One of Music.app's own counts, up to the largest signed 32-bit integer.

listenbrainz_info.$comment: Every documented additional_info key. The patternProperties entry marks each key without the ls_ prefix as evaluated, so a record's unevaluatedProperties: false rejects only undefined ls_ keys (ruling S3).

duration_played.$comment: Seconds heard, up to the track duration's 24-day ceiling (ruling L2).

duration_played_ms.$comment: Milliseconds heard, up to the track duration's 24-day ceiling (ruling L2).

listensmith_track.$comment: The ls_ keys every record may carry: identity (D2), source (A8, S2), media type (C7), the play ID (A5, H2), and the Music.app fields read when a play starts (F1 to F4).

ls_source.description: Where the audio came from (rulings A8 and S2); not the submitting client, which is submission_client. local_file requires ls_file_path, catalog requires ls_catalog_id.

ls_media_type.description: The kind of audio (ruling C7); a record without it reads as music.

ls_file_path.description: The audio file's path on the machine that played it (ruling D2); required when ls_source is local_file.

ls_persistent_id.description: The player's own persistent ID for the track (ruling D2).

ls_catalog_id.description: The streaming catalog's ID for the track, in place of a path (ruling A8); required when ls_source is catalog.

ls_play_id.description: A unique ID for one play, shared by every piece of that play (rulings A5 and H2). Lowercase only: the scrobbler lowercases its UUID (Swift writes uppercase), so the repeat key compares equal for the same play.

ls_album_artist.description: The album artist tag, when it differs from the track artist (ruling D2).

ls_disc_number.description: The disc number within a multi-disc release (ruling D2), up to 999 like ls_disc_count (ruling L4).

ls_genre.description: The genre tag as the player holds it (ruling D2).

ls_track_count.description: How many tracks the disc holds (ruling F1).

ls_disc_count.description: How many discs the release holds (ruling F1).

ls_compilation.description: Whether the track is part of a compilation (ruling F1).

ls_bpm.description: The beats-per-minute tag (ruling F1). Music.app holds 0 for none, and the adapter then omits the key, so 0 is refused.

ls_work.description: The classical work the track belongs to (ruling F1).

ls_movement.description: The movement's name within its work (ruling F1).

ls_movement_number.description: The movement's number within its work (ruling F1).

ls_movement_count.description: How many movements the work has (ruling F1).

ls_music_rating.description: Music.app's own rating of the track, 20 per star (ruling F2). Read when the play starts, so it is the opinion held when the play began.

ls_music_favorited.description: Whether Music.app holds the track as a favorite (ruling F2). Read when the play starts, so it is the opinion held when the play began.

ls_music_disliked.description: Whether Music.app holds the track as disliked (ruling F2). Read when the play starts, so it is the opinion held when the play began.

ls_music_album_favorited.description: Whether Music.app holds the track's album as a favorite (ruling F2). Read when the play starts, so it is the opinion held when the play began.

ls_music_album_disliked.description: Whether Music.app holds the track's album as disliked (ruling F2). Read when the play starts, so it is the opinion held when the play began.

ls_kind.description: Music.app's kind string for the file, for example MPEG audio file (ruling F3).

ls_bit_rate.description: The file's bit rate in kilobits per second (ruling F3).

ls_sample_rate.description: The file's sample rate in hertz (ruling F3).

ls_music_date_added.description: When the track entered Music.app's library, as Unix seconds (ruling F4). Music.app's own value, read when the play starts.

ls_music_played_count.description: Music.app's own play count, never listensmith's (ruling F4). Read when the play starts, so it counts the plays BEFORE this one: Music.app updates it only after a play finishes.

ls_music_skipped_count.description: Music.app's own skip count (ruling F4). Read when the play starts, so it describes the track before this play.

ls_music_played_date.description: Music.app's own last-played time, as Unix seconds (ruling F4). Read when the play starts, so it is the play BEFORE this one: Music.app updates it only after a play finishes.
